10 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards, counted per quiz prompt) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools. They are seven distinct card-and-reading pairs, because the 柄 ら, いきおい and つく collisions each appear on both the がら and え prompts: the KANJIDIC2 name readings 旋 せ (offered by 世), 朗 あき (秋 空) and お (小 御 男 緒), 柄 ら (等) and 桜 さ (小 早 然), and the card-text readings 柄 いきおい (勢) and つく (付 就 点 着 突).

No KANJIDIC2 name-only reading can be drawn as a wrong option in the checked pools, and no one-holder Starter case exists. The first gate run showed 柄 ら drawable on the がら prompt of a Starter practice session that borrows 等, because the third curated distractor 札 is not a Starter card and left a slot to the random fallback; 札 was replaced by the Starter card 休, so the three curated distractors 木 本 休 fill every slot.
4 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (一旦, 凱旋, 蒸し暑い, 西暦) are pre-existing and out of scope: each line wraps, so the entry id is on the next line.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed, including common ones such as 旗 キ, 既 キ, 旨 うま.い and むね, 暑 ショ, 暦 こよみ, 朗 ロウ, 条 すじ, 架 か.ける, 柄 つか, 染 そ.める and し.みる, 株 シュ and 桜 オウ; eight cards quiz only their on reading (施 シ, 旋 セン, 旦 タン, 旨 シ, 暦 レキ, 条 ジョウ, 架 カ, 染 セン) and seven only their kun readings (旗 はた, 既 すで.に, 暑 あつ.い, 朗 ほが.らか, 柄 がら and え, 株 かぶ, 桜 さくら).

Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options: 施 "carry" (提, 運) and "give" (産, 返), 旗 "standard" (準, 範, 規), 暑 "weather" (候, 寒, 曇) and "season" (旬, 春, 節), 条 "line" (弧), 株 "plant" (挿, 植, 稲, 苗) and 桜 "tree" (幹, 松, 桂, 梓, 梨, 椋, 楠). No Notes bullet on these cards separates those senses. Cards with a defensible overlap are excluded symmetrically (for example 施 with 与, 贈, 給; 暑 with 夏, 熱; 旋 with 回, 転; 染 with 色), and the only exclusion pair among the new cards is 株 and 桜.
